race.title: Thoroughbred Breeders' Association Supporting Breeders' Day Mares' Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
race.verdict: A well-contested race of its type. OLIVE NOIR makes plenty of appeal on paper for a yard with a fine record in bumpers, so she earns the tentative vote before market clues. Galant Jewel and Fiercestone have both been successful on their second outing in Irish points and can put that experience to good use, while Autumn In Sonora is another to note being a half-sister to smart hurdler/useful chase winner Potters Charm. OLIVE NOIR (IRE) GALANT JEWEL (IRE) FIERCESTONE (IRE)
